description.value: Empire Donuts is a scratch-made donut shop with a small chain of locations in Victoria and Duncan, operating under the motto 'A Hole Lotta' Love.' All donuts are made by hand from quality ingredients and sold until they run out each day. The View Street shop sits in central Victoria, making it a convenient sugar-and-carb stop for urban cyclists.
